newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's CPC issues tender to buy Nov 1-15 MTBE.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC issues tender to buy Nov 1-15 MTBE.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) for November 1-15 delivery, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis, a CPC source said on Thursday.
The tender is based on two options.
In the first case, CPC seeks a 3,500-tonne parcel for delivery to Keelung or Kaohsiung.
In the second case, CPC seeks 7,000 tonnes of MTBE to Keelung or Kaohsiung on a one-port or two-port discharge basis at CPC's option.
The tender closes on September 24 and offers should be valid until September 26.
In its last tender, CPC bought 7,000 tonnes of MTBE for October 1-15 delivery at $280 per tonne, c-and-f Kaohsiung or Keelung.
MTBE is an additive added to gasoline to boost its octane number.
